name: Stablecoin supply contraction -> de-risk / short (BTC/ETH, redemptions leaving perimeter)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the two long-gate variants: this trades the OTHER side of the same regime axis — it goes SHORT when stablecoin supply CONTRACTS, harvesting the de-risking leg rather than gating a long): a shrinking stablecoin_mcap means capital physically leaving the crypto perimeter (redemptions to fiat), which precedes/accompanies de-risking and drawdowns (2025 Q4: 22% crypto-backed-stable contraction into a falling tape). When contraction coincides with weakening price momentum (ret_Nd turning negative), a short harvests the liquidity-withdrawal down-leg. Exit when supply stabilizes (mcap cross_up back to flat) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: shorting crypto is dangerous — KILL if the DD cap (<=25%) is blown by shorting into a squeeze. DISCONFIRMER 2: mcap is laggy -> the contraction may register AFTER the drop; require a positive forward predictive coefficient for the short at k>=1 after BH-FDR, else it is coincident and useless. DISCONFIRMER 3: if a plain negative-momentum short matches it, the stablecoin feature adds nothing. High death probability — a regime-symmetry test. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: stablecoin supply contraction into weakening momentum
